name: orb-vertex-lineage-through-geometry-reduction
instr:
orb cannot trace transformed coordinates to exact vertices or normalized segment positions in the original nested geometry. Add composable lineage without changing geometry, mutation, filtering, metadata, ordering, or document encoding behavior.

`VertexRef.Valid` from `github.com/paulmach/orb` must accept zero-based vertices and inclusive finite segment references, rejecting negative indices and invalid fractions. `GeometryLineage.Validate` must require one ordered origin per coordinate-bearing output vertex, recursively match concrete branch kinds, shapes, and vertex counts across nested and empty geometries, and report the first mismatching path. `ComposeLineage` must resolve final origins against the initial input, combine fractions, and return no partial result when incompatible.

`DouglasPeucker`, `Radial`, and `Visvalingam` from `github.com/paulmach/orb/simplify` must record their actual survivors, including duplicate indices, forced endpoints, heap stopping, minimum retention, closures, nil values, and removed branches. Keep `DouglasPeucker(threshold)`, `Radial(df, threshold)`, and `Visvalingam(threshold, minPointsToKeep)`.

`project.GeometryWithLineage(g, proj)` must preserve exact origins and recursive alignment. `clip.GeometryWithLineage(b, g)` must distinguish retained vertices from boundary intersections and record their original segment fractions. `resample.ResampleWithLineage(ls, df, totalPoints)` and `resample.ToIntervalWithLineage(ls, df, dist)` must give end
